idea-plugin.name: France E-Invoice Reception
idea-plugin.description:
12 checks for the French mandatory mentions a PDP rejects, on Factur-X, UBL and CII invoices

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → France E-Invoice Reception: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/france-einvoice-reception-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free: check the file you open — every finding on its line, with the fix.
Pro (JetBrains Marketplace licence): Tools → France E-Invoice Reception: Check Whole Project sweeps every matching file in the project and writes a dated HTML and CSV report you can attach to a review or an audit.

Web version and rule list: getreadystack.com/tools/france-einvoice-reception-lint
